mechanisms.message: except is not supported: Cerbos except(list, list) computes a list difference, which has no JPA Criteria translation. Rewrite the policy with a collection macro instead — e.g. size(R.attr.tags.except(["x"])) > 0 is equivalent to R.attr.tags.exists(t, !(t in ["x"])).

mechanisms.message: arithmetic composed on a division whose denominator may be zero is not supported: CEL carries the resulting NaN or infinity through the surrounding arithmetic and SQL has no value that does
mechanisms.reason: CEL carries a NaN or signed infinity through the arithmetic composed on top of a division, and SQL has no value that does — the NULLIF divide-by-zero guard turns the whole sum into NULL. The reference's non-finite rewrite only reaches a division that IS the comparison operand, so a division nested inside further arithmetic fails closed rather than emitting the under-granting filter

pins.message: mod is not supported in comparisons: CEL % is integer-only while attribute values are always doubles at check time, so a satisfiable policy must cast with int() first

timestamp() comparison requires a column mapped to java.time.Instant or java.time.OffsetDateTime, but 'request.resource.attr.createdBy' maps to String. Other temporal representations (LocalDateTime, java.util.Date, String) are ambiguous about the absolute instant they store; remap the column or register an OperatorFunction override for 'lt'.
